cohort: A convenience sample of 84 birth center sites providing 90,580 episodes of perinatal care to medically low-risk multiparas and healthy consumers.
finding: The birth center model of care demonstrates safety and effectiveness across various staffing and business models, with outcomes exceeding national benchmarks, although high annual birth volume was associated with increased induction, cesarean birth, and decreased breastfeeding success.
mod_finding: Increased rates of induction of labor and cesarean birth were present within practices characterized as high volume (>200 births/year).
